svg.title: TextMAE codec
svg.desc: (a) The MAE codec: a ViT encoder and g_a map the kept patches to a latent y that is quantized and arithmetic-coded; g_s and a ViT decoder reconstruct the image, inserting mask tokens at the dropped positions given by the Huffman-coded patch positions. (b) The entropy model: a hyperprior and a channel-wise context model predict a Gaussian for every latent.
